name: ATM Service Type 13 Code
definition: Type of service to be offered for a customer at an ATM.

ASTS.name: Account Statements
ASTS.definition: Request a full statement (that is a legal statement) related to a customer account.

PINC.name: PIN Change
PINC.definition: Modification of the card PIN value.

PRFL.name: Profile Withdrawal
PRFL.definition: Amount and notes Values are pre-defined by the customer profile.

PATH.name: Pre Authorised Withdrawal
PATH.definition: Withdrawal transaction was pre-authorised by another channel, for instance a mobile. The amount could be absent from the withdrawal request message.

CHSN.name: Chosen Withdrawal
CHSN.definition: Amount and notes values are chosen by the customer.

TRFC.name: Customer Transfer
TRFC.definition: Funds transfer between accounts belonging to the customer in the same bank.

DPSN.name: Non Verified Deposit
DPSN.definition: Deposit of media items unverified by the ATM, for instance in an envelope.

DPSV.name: Verified Deposit
DPSV.definition: Deposit of media items verified by the ATM.

TRFP.name: Payment
TRFP.definition: Funds transfer to pay a third party.
